correctness.rationale: For every a,b,c>=1 with inherited Manhattan metric and inclusive threshold 2, the earlier rigorous exact all-box theorem implies the homotopy wedge^{abc}S3 and integral unit-cube basis. The submitted proof also uses valid coordinate-clamp retractions from equal cubes, local Euler weights w(0,0,0)=1 and w(d)=-1 if all d_i>=1 (else zero), and maximal even-parity tetrahedron coefficient functionals providing a split integral basis. An independently implemented clique recursion exactly verified all 27 local Euler identities, without relying on the submitted output log. An independent antipodal-pair orientation computation checked every one of the 48 signed coordinate automorphisms, yielding 24 positive and 24 negative signs and sign(pi) for each. Filtered unions and basis compatibility prove the infinite direct-sum statement (finite support) and the affine action. These are genuinely correct statements, although they were previously available by implication. No finite computation is treated as proof for unbounded boxes.

The finite local count and 48-symmetry checks corroborate only their bounded algebraic/finite identities; the all-box conclusion uses the analytic and topological arguments.

originality.rationale: Decisive earlier coverage. The October 18 finite Manhattan-box theorem proves exactly the same integral rank abc, 3-sphere wedge, unit-cube integral basis and inclusion compatibility, with broader all-scale persistence. Its inclusion-compatible basis yields the direct-limit infinite-lattice basis and translation action. A second October 18 full paper computes the same four-antipodal-pair cube S3 orientation character under all 48 signed coordinate symmetries as sign of the permutation of four body-diagonal pairs. Under the 3D coordinate action this character equals the sign of the axis permutation (independent 48-element exact check). Applying that known local character to every previously proved unit-cube basis generator recovers the full remaining signed module, including positive reflection signs. No genuinely original theorem remains; this is a mathematical implication of the two earlier published results, not a negative keyword search.
residual_risks: The June 2026 Galetto–Montaño–Wellner full article was not read; its abstract likely supplies additional earlier local character coverage.
Exact orientation bases are defined only up to choice of signs, but the known uniform representative convention fixes the global character and does not create a new theorem.
The two independently published October 18 results are sufficiently strong for rejection without relying on inaccessible sources.

value.rationale: Exact homology classes of three-dimensional lattice boxes and their crystallographic action are natural and intrinsically meaningful invariants. However, the submitted result does not supply a new needed value of either invariant: the entire exact box classification and integral cube basis are already proved in the earlier full persistence theorem, and the remaining 48-element local orientation character is explicitly computed in another earlier full theorem. Translation and finite-support direct limits are formal consequences of the published natural basis; their composition is not a separately motivated unknown classification. Repeating these results with a 27-case enumeration and recasting the known local sign as a lattice module does not constitute new mathematical value under the stated standard. No independent correct, original, valuable remainder remains for repair.
residual_risks: A new equivariant refinement beyond the cited orientation character could have value, but none is established by this frozen source; no speculative repair is asserted.
